methodology: Hand-authored from generic low-voltage MCU, I2C electrical-budget, power-envelope, source-ownership, reference-plane, decoupling-geometry, LED, component-contract, board-rule, and scope invariants. No competitor fixture, output, or annotation was used. Fault and clean controls are transformations of a separately authored CC0 acceptance design.
